newsitem.title: USA: Community Medical to acquire ambulance firm.
newsitem.headline: Community Medical to acquire ambulance firm.

text.p: Community Medical Transport Inc said on Monday it signed a letter of intent to acquire a company which provides ambulance and ambulette services.

The acquisition is anticipated to close in the first quarter of 1997. The transaction, between Community and the northern New Jersey company, is expected to be made for cash and a note. Community Medical said it believes the company to be acquired has annual revenues in excess of $1.5 million.

A spokesman for Community Medical, providers of medical transportation services in New York and New Jersey, said they were unable to name their intended acquisition until a definitive agreement is reached.
